# EnergyLandscapeLabelPropagation

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The mechanism by which the Hopfield network's energy minima guide the assignment of labels to unlabeled patterns based on proximity to labeled attractors. Provides a theoretical foundation for scalable, unsupervised pattern completion in neuromorphic hardware, crucial for in-network associative memory.
